services.name: Moonlight Cruise
services.desc: Prepare to drink in the breathtaking Downtown WPB skyline by moonlight on the Hakuna Matata Catamaran! Duration 90 minutes About Set sail on a magical 90-minute moonlit cruise aboard the Hakuna Matata Catamaran, departing from Downtown West Palm Beach. Glide along the scenic Palm Beach coastline while marveling at the breathtaking city skyline illuminated against the night sky. Enjoy refreshing beverages, lively music, and an unforgettable atmosphere—perfect for groups, celebrations, or anyone looking for a fun and relaxing evening on the water. Whether you're gathering friends or making new ones, this party boat guarantees a memorable night of singing, dancing, and moonlight magic.

services.desc: Local Sportfishing Charters – Palm Beach’s Premier Offshore Fishing Adventure Step aboard our 40’ Invincible Catamaran and experience the ultimate offshore fishing charter in Palm Beach!
